name: Booking app
description: Visitors pick a time slot and leave their name and email; bookings are saved in Postgres and confirmed by email.

env.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
env.description: Password for /admin (the booking list). Username can be anything.

env.name: MAIL_FROM
env.description: Sender address for confirmation emails. Must be on your verified domain, e.g. bookings@yourdomain.com

env.name: BUSINESS_NAME
env.description: Name shown on the page and in emails (optional)

env.name: OWNER_EMAIL
env.description: Get a copy of each new booking by email (optional)
